# pf-a11y-audit

Audit PatternFly components and pages against WCAG and ARIA best practices. Use when reviewing accessibility, fixing screen reader issues, or validating ARIA usage in PatternFly-based applications.

**Plugin**: [pf-a11y](index.md) | **:material-check: User-invocable**

## Usage

```bash
/pf-a11y-audit
```
